urdu.name: فردوسی
urdu.long_meaning: Ferdousi (فردوسی) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم فردوسی، جنت سے منسوب ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

arabic.long_meaning: Ferdousi (فِرْدَوْسِي) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الْفِرْدَوْسِيّ، مَنْسُوبٌ إِلَى الْفِرْدَوْس. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.question: What does Ferdousi mean?
faq.answer: Ferdousi is associated with the Arabic form فِرْدَوْسِي, whose core sense is ferdousi; of paradise (feminine).

faq.question: What is the origin of Ferdousi?
faq.answer: Ferdousi is associated with Arabic. Ferdousi is the feminine relative form of Arabic فِرْدَوْس (Firdaws), meaning 'paradise'; it occurs in the Quran.

faq.question: Is Ferdousi an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form فِرْدَوْسِي is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Ferdousi an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Ferdousi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Ferdousi a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Ferdousi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Firdaws occurs in the Quran as a term for the highest paradise.

faq.answer: In Urdu, Ferdousi is rendered فردوسی and carries the sense فردوسی، جنت سے منسوب.

faq.question: What does Ferdousi mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Ferdousi is rendered فردوسی and carries the sense فردوسی، منسوب به فردوس.

faq.question: How is Ferdousi pronounced?
faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is fer-dou-si. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.question: What are the variants of Ferdousi?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Ferdousi, ferdousi. Script forms are فردوسي, فردوسی, فِرْدَوْسِي, फ़िरदौसी.
